title: Rationally connected smooth projective targets of lower-dimensional or codimension-one ramified dominant rational maps from Calabi–Yau or irreducible symplectic varieties

difficulty_reason: The authors combine pseudoeffective reflexive differential subsheaves, quasi-étale trivializations and preservation under Q-factorialization with an MRC contradiction; in the symplectic case the pulled-back top form is forced to degenerate along a positive-dimensional fiber.
